title: ancistrachne numaeensis
intro: Ancistrachne numaeensis, commonly known as Niuhi, is a plant species native to the Pacific Islands, specifically in the Hawaiian Islands and the Society Islands. It is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. The plant has been traditionally used in Polynesian medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin disorders, due to its health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Ancistrachne numaeensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
